# apt-hosted (apt hosted) at http://gateway.test/gw
# set ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN to a credential with access to this repository
# note: APT hosted repositories are a management-only preview: clients cannot install from them until signed snapshots are published

## APT source — /etc/apt/sources.list.d/apt-hosted.list
deb http://gateway.test/gw/apt/apt-hosted <suite> <component>

## APT credentials — /etc/apt/auth.conf.d/apt-hosted.conf
machine gateway.test/gw/apt/apt-hosted
login ci
password ${ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN}
